TAP::action
Description
Command for indication that TAP module wants to get insight from any module. TAP::insight must be invoked if flag is set to true.
Syntax
TAP
::
insight_requested
TAP::insight_requested
Return boolean value if TAP modules wants to get an insight from any module.
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL
Introduced: BIGIP-15.1
